conferences.title: The ELIXIR 3D-BioInfo Annual General Meeting (AGM) | ISCB 3DSig 2026
conferences.summary: The ELIXIR 3D-BioInfo Annual General Meeting (AGM) | ISCB 3DSig 2026 is a joint conference of the ELIXIR 3D-BioInfo and ISCB 3DSIG Communities, held 25-27 November 2026 in Rome, Italy. It brings together structural bioinformatics researchers for networking and to exchange ideas on workflows and resources for new developments in data and methods.

conferences.title: Introduction to RNA-seq and functional interpretation 2027
conferences.summary: A five-day virtual course guiding participants through the core technology, data analysis approaches, tools, and resources used in RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) and transcriptomics. It combines pre-recorded lectures, live presentations, trainer Q&A sessions, and computational practicals.
conferences.student: Financial assistance is available to a limited number of participants attending this course.

conferences.title: Introduction to multi-omics data integration and visualisation 2027
conferences.summary: This introductory course will highlight the challenges that researchers face in integrating multi-omics datasets. The course will focus on biological examples in a practice oriented way, using public data resources and open access tools, with an emphasis on visualisation.
conferences.student: Financial assistance is available to a limited number of participants attending this course. For full details, please refer to our dedicated support page for in

conferences.title: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis with Python 2027
conferences.summary: A virtual five-day EMBL-EBI Training course covering the analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing data using Python and command-line tools, from raw reads to cell clusters. It includes live sessions, practicals, and a group challenge.
conferences.student: Financial assistance is available to a limited number of participants attending this course.

conferences.title: Proteomics bioinformatics 2027
conferences.summary: This course provides hands-on training in the basics of mass spectrometry (MS) and proteomics bioinformatics. The practical elements of the course will take raw data from a proteomics experiment and analyse it.

conferences.title: Exploring microbial communities through metagenomics bioinformatics 2027
conferences.summary: A virtual EMBL-EBI training course providing a practical introduction to metagenomics bioinformatics, focusing on assembly-based approaches and metagenome-assembled genomes (MAGs). It covers quality control, decontamination, assembly, functional annotation, and public resources such as MGnify, ENA, HMMER, and InterPro.

conferences.title: Methods for infectious disease modelling using genomics
conferences.summary: A live training course at EMBL-EBI teaching concepts, methods, and tools for infectious disease modelling using genomics, including compartmental models, pathogen evolution models, and phylodynamics. It is aimed at early-stage researchers and professionals in infectious diseases or pathogen evolution.

conferences.title: Genome bioinformatics: from short- to long-read sequencing 2027
conferences.summary: A live training course at EMBL-EBI covering the technology, analysis workflows, tools, and resources for next-generation sequencing data analysis, focusing on sequence informatics, re-sequencing, differences between short- and long-read sequencing, and variant calling. It is currently in development, with applications opening on 4 May 2027.

conferences.title: Data science for life scientists
conferences.summary: This course introduces you to practical data-science skills that are increasingly essential in modern life-science research. Using Python, you'll learn how to prepare, process, and visualise key biological data types, and you gain hands-on experience training and evaluating machine-learning models with real, publicly available datasets.

conferences.title: Structural bioinformatics 2027
conferences.summary: A virtual EMBL-EBI Training course providing a guide to commonly used methods and tools in structural bioinformatics to analyse and interpret experimentally determined and AI-predicted macromolecular structure data. Applications open 2 March 2027.

conferences.title: Interpreting the effects of genetic variants on protein structure and function
conferences.summary: This six-hour virtual workshop will provide participants with an opportunity to gain hands-on experience of using EMBL-EBI tools and resources to assess the effects of genetic variants on the structure and function of proteins in a common workflow.
